_template_notes.purpose: Backend Domain graph — Discovery Plugin #11 (v2.0 Gói C++ Stage 2.2). Parse C# DDD patterns: AggregateRoot, Entity, ValueObject, DomainEvent, DomainEventHandler, Specification. Source: Serena `find_symbol` cho DDD base types + Grep fallback `: AggregateRoot|: Entity<|: ValueObject|: I?DomainEvent`. Consumed by lane CD16 (Domain Logic Integrity) qua graph_dependency.
populate: nodes[]: 1 entry per DDD type — {id, name, kind, module, file_path, line, base_types[], properties_count, fingerprint}
properties_count: số public properties (heuristic Grep — v2.1 AST chính xác hơn)
edges[]: 1 entry per relationship — {from, to, kind: 'inherits_from|uses_value_object|raises_event|handles_event|aggregates|references_entity', file?}
uses_value_object: AggregateRoot có property type ValueObject
metadata.build_at: ISO 8601 timestamp khi graph built
metadata.scope_root: 'apps/backend' (v2.0 chỉ scan main backend — microservices defer v3)
metadata.source_method: 'serena_find_symbol|grep_fallback' (Serena primary + Grep fallback per Protocol 20)
metadata.parser_version: '1.0' (Grep + line-based parse). v2.1 → Roslyn-based syntax tree analyzer.
metadata.kinds_distribution: count per kind cho quick overview
metadata.modules_covered: list of module short names có DDD types
skip_conditions: Project KHÔNG có apps/backend/ → SKIP, write empty graph với skipped:true (lane CD16 sẽ fallback Serena/Grep với E133 WARN)
Tech stack backend != .NET → SKIP, log E137 WARN (parser chỉ support C# DDD conventions)
Không tìm thấy DDD pattern nào (0 aggregate_root + 0 entity + 0 value_object) → write nodes=[] với skipped:false + WARN E139 (downstream lane Grep fallback)
